title: Paginate rewritten with page-count arithmetic
description: A negative control: pagination is rewritten to derive a page count and index, which looks off-by-one but produces identical, correct pages.

expectedNoFindingZones.reason: The 1-based pageNumber (pageIndex + 1) and slice(start, start + pageSize) correctly cover the final partial page, and the pageSize < 1 guard rules out the degenerate case, so there is no off-by-one to report.
